notes: Test-driven-development skill body used as always-loaded instructions; the main behaviour is writing a failing test before production code, including under time pressure or 'tests after' requests.

protected.why: the whole point of the file: no production code without a failing test first
patterns: (?i)failing test first|test first|write the test first

protected.why: keeping untested code as reference defeats test-first
a test never seen failing proves nothing
unreported red tests falsify the report
regressions return without a reproducing test
patterns: (?i)never fix bugs without a test|bug[^\n]{0,40}failing test

checks.rule: NO PRODUCTION CODE WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST ... "I'll test after": Tests written after pass immediately, which proves nothing.
